title.en: Register to Vote or Update Your Address Online for November Election

description.en:
Voter registration for the November General Election is available online. Stearns County Auditor-Treasurer Randy Schreifels reminds residents that eligible voters can register or update their existing registration anytime by visiting mnvotes.gov.

Online voter registration is accessible 24 hours a day, seven days a week, making it easy and convenient for individuals to ensure they are ready to vote this fall. Pre-registration for the November General Election is open until October 13, 2026. Voters who register on or before this deadline will have their names included on the roster at their polling place for the November 3, 2026 General Election.

Residents with questions can contact the Stearns County Auditor-Treasurer’s Office at 320 656 3920 or email elections@stearnscountymn.gov.

description.en:
Thursday, October 15 is the due date for 2026 second half residential property taxes. Note: second half agricultural property and mobile home taxes are due Monday, November 16. Payments received after this date are subject to penalties as set by the State of Minnesota. 

Stearns County collects property taxes on behalf of schools, cities, townships, and other taxing districts. Late payments can directly affect their operating budgets. Timely payments help ensure local services continue without disruption.

Payment Options

  • Pay Online 
    Residents can pay online through the Stearns County Property Access System using e-Check (free) or Credit card (2.5% service fee). Online users can “Pay Now” or “Schedule Future Payments”.

  Did you know? Online payments are often more secure than mailing a check due to encryption, real-time monitoring, and
  fraud-detection systems. Mailed checks can be stolen, altered, or lost in transit.

  • Pay In Person
    Payments can be made at either Treasurer’s Office location:
    • Stearns County Service Center, 3301 County Road 138, Waite Park, 2nd Floor. Current-year payments may also be dropped off in the drive-thru with a payment stub.
    • Stearns County Administration Center, 705 Courthouse Square, Room 136, St. Cloud.

Offices are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

  • Pay by Mail 
    Include your second-half payment stub(s) and/or Parcel ID Number, along with a check payable to: Stearns County Auditor-Treasurer, and mail to:

Randy R. Schreifels, Auditor-Treasurer
P.O. Box 728
St. Cloud, MN 56302 0728

 The postmark date serves as the official payment date.

 If you are close to the deadline, bring your payment inside the post office and request a manual postmark. Local
 mail is now routed to regional facilities and may not be postmarked the same day.

  • Set Up ACH Payments for 2027
    Residents may enroll in an automatic ACH payment plan for next year. Payments are deducted from a checking or savings account and can be scheduled quarterly or over a 10 month period. The program is free, easy to start, and easy to cancel. Visit stearns.co/taxpayments and select “Payment Plans.” The enrollment deadline for 2027 ACH plans is December 15, 2026.
